name: Ledger
short_desc: Invoices for a one-person business: recurring invoices, the quarter's export for the Steuerberater, payments.
author: Florian Geymayer
description: Server for Ledger and the web app it serves at its own address: write and issue invoices with gap-free numbers and immutable PDFs, export a quarter or a year as a ZIP of PDFs and CSVs for the Steuerberater, and match payments (by hand or from a CSV). The desktop app (macOS, Windows) pairs with the same server. Open the app's domain in a browser and pair with the setup code from the app's log.
